description: Your first tool: bonk robots and seal silo cracks.
+12% wrench, maul and scythe damage per level.
+8% wrench, maul and scythe swing speed per level.
A reliable rivet gun: 12 damage, 10 rounds, 40 m.
+2 magazine and -8% reload time per level.
Seven pellets spread across a short cone and shove back nearby groups.
Slow precise shots reach across the farm and punch through a second robot.
Each level lets a rifle round pass through one more robot.
Lob a shell onto the crosshair that bursts across a group of tough robots.
A slow front-facing swing that crushes everything in front of you and shoves it back.
A 360-degree sweep that clears robots surrounding you.
